android.desc: Friendly for Instagram is the most complete browser & downloader for Instagram, Twitter, Facebook, TikTok and all your other social media accounts. Friendly, by Sensor Tower, is a collection of smart tools for your all your social media accounts. - A FAST MULTI-ACCOUNT BROWSER, to quickly check all your social media accounts - A POWERFUL MEDIA DOWNLOADER, that works well with video, photos, gif, across posts, stories and messages. - A NIFTY IMAGE & WATERMARK EDITOR, to create the perfect repost - Works across Instagram, Twitter, Facebook, Messenger, TikTok, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Reddit and more. Our apps contains no-ads, no subscriptions, no gimmicks. If you like the app, you can choose to tip us and unlock a few advanced features. We rely on word of mouth, so please also consider telling your friends about Friendly and leaving a good review. Key Features ◆ ACCESS ALL YOUR SOCIAL ACCOUNTS ◆ Friendly's browser is designed to manage multiple profiles (cookies & website data spaces). You can add as many Instagram, Facebook, Twitter (or any other website) accounts as you want. ◆ DOWNLOAD ANY MEDIA ◆ Friendly's browser makes it easy to download any video, picture or gif to your device. ◆ DO MORE WITH VIDEOS ◆ Our advanced video player can: pause, seek, change speed or download. ◆ DO MORE WITH PHOTOS ◆ Our photo viewer make it easy to Zoom, download, edit pictures. ◆ EDIT & REPOST PHOTOS ◆ Our advanced watermark editor gives you full control : text, colors, avatar, opacity, position. ◆ SAVE BATTERY LIFE ◆ Our browser is optimized to use the lite version of the mobile sites. We provide dark mode for Instagram, Facebook and other social sites. Our design and animations are optimized to use less power. We use less services and background tasks than native social apps, and provide the option to disable all notifications or choose a check frequency. ◆ SAVE SPACE ON YOUR DEVICE ◆ Our lightweight browser optimize storage and cache, and with one lite app, you can access all your social accounts. ◆ CUSTOMIZE YOUR EXPERIENCE ◆ Change and apply your own color theme. Easy dark mode access. Discover our compact mode for your feed. Copyright Notice Friendly IQ is a browser made by Friendly App Studio.
